```{r }
################################################################################
#        SIMULACION + MUESTREO + AJUSTE INLA (VERSION MONTECARLO)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Simulación: escenario 3 (simulacion completa)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Especificación del modelo: efecto espacial residual + covariable rw2
################################################################################

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ----------------------------    PRELIMINARES    ------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Librerias necesarias:
library(fields)
library(INLA)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Semilla para reproducibilidad:
set.seed(1423)  

# Funciones para el cálculo de medidas de evaluacion:
# RMSE:
rmse <- function(est, true) {
  sqrt(mean((est - true)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}
# NRMSE:
nrmse <- function(est, true) {
  sqrt(mean((est - true)^2, na.rm = TRUE))/sd(true)
}
# MAE:
mae <- function(est, true) {
  mean(abs(est - true), na.rm = TRUE)
}
# Correlacion de Pearson:
corr.p <- function(est, true) {
  cor(est, true, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
}
# Correlacion de Spearman:
corr.s <- function(est, true) {
  cor(est, true, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
}



# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ----------------------------     SIMULACIÓN     ------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -------------------------
# 1. Dominio espacial
# -------------------------
# Malla de puntos:
dims <- 101 #dimensiones
n <- dims^2
grid_list <- list(x = seq(0, 100, length = dims),
                  y = seq(0, 100, length = dims))

# Coordenadas:
lon <- rep(grid_list$x, times = dims)
lat <- rep(grid_list$y, each = dims)



# --------------------------------------
# 2. Generación de campos espaciales
# --------------------------------------
# Beta espacial (Matérn):
cov_beta.real <- matern.image.cov(grid = grid_list,
                                  theta = 10,       
                                  smoothness = 1.2, 
                                  setup = TRUE)
beta.real_field <- sim.rf(cov_beta.real) * 0.5 
beta.real_matrix <- matrix(beta.real_field, nrow = dims, ncol = dims)

# Covariable X (gradiente + ruido local):
X_det <- scale(lon + lat)           
X_noise <- rnorm(dims*dims, 0, 0.5) 
X_matrix <- matrix(X_det + X_noise, nrow = dims, ncol = dims)

# Efecto combinado beta*X:
eta.real_matrix <- beta.real_matrix * X_matrix

# Campo espacial residual (Matérn):
cov_error <- matern.image.cov(grid = grid_list,
                              theta = 15,
                              smoothness = 0.8,
                              setup = TRUE)
error_field <- sim.rf(cov_error)
error_matrix <- matrix(error_field, nrow = dims, ncol = dims)

# Recalibrar beta para equilibrar varianzas:
var_eta <- var(as.vector(eta.real_matrix))
var_error <- var(as.vector(error_matrix))
factor_beta.real <- sqrt(var_error / var_eta)
beta.real_matrix <- beta.real_matrix * factor_beta.real
eta.real_matrix <- beta.real_matrix * X_matrix

# Comprobación de varianza y rango:
cat("Varianza beta*X:", var(as.vector(eta.real_matrix)), "\n")
cat("Varianza error:", var(as.vector(error_matrix)), "\n")
cat("Rango beta*X:", range(eta.real_matrix), "\n")
cat("Rango error:", range(error_matrix), "\n")

# Error iid pequeño:
sigma_iid <- 0.3
error_iid <- matrix(rnorm(dims*dims, 0, sigma_iid), nrow = dims, ncol = dims)

# Respuesta final:
y_matrix <- eta.real_matrix + error_matrix + error_iid



#---------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plots para inspección visual
# --------------------------------------------------
# Paletas de colores:
cols_main <- hcl.colors(100, "Spectral", rev = TRUE)
cols_err <- colorRampPalette(c("blue2", "white", "red2"))(100)

# Dataframes con los valores de cada componente:
df_error <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_error$value <- as.vector(error_matrix)

df_X <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_X$value <- as.vector(X_matrix)

df_beta <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_beta$value <- as.vector(beta.real_matrix)

df_eta <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_eta$value <- as.vector(eta.real_matrix)

df_y <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_y$value <- as.vector(y_matrix)

# Efecto espacial residual:
p1 <- ggplot(df_error, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main) +
  labs(title = expression("Efecto espacial residual " ~ alpha(s)), x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

# Covariable:
p2 <- ggplot(df_X, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main) +
  labs(title = expression("Covariable " ~ X), x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

# Coeficiente espacial beta:
p3 <- ggplot(df_beta, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main) +
  labs(title = expression(atop(
"Coeficiente espacialmente", "variable" ~ beta(s))), x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

# Efecto combinado beta * covariable:
p4 <- ggplot(df_eta, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main) +
  labs(title = expression(atop("Efecto espacial asociado a",  "la covariable" ~
                               eta(s) == beta(s) %.% X)),
       x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

# Respuesta:
p5 <- ggplot(df_y, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main) +
  labs(title = expression(atop("Respuesta", y(s) == alpha(s) + beta(s) %.% X)),
       x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p1 + p2 + 
p4 + p3 + 
p5 + plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)





# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# -----------------------------  MUESTREO + INLA  ------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
n_reps <- 100    # replicas montecarlo
n_samples <- 500      # número de puntos muestreados
n_x <- 10     # numero de grupos para la discretizacion

# Matrices para guardar predicciones completas de cada repetición:
y_hat_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = n_reps)
alpha_hat_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = n_reps)

# Vectores para guardar medidas resumen:
dic_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
waic_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)

rmse_y_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
nrmse_y_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
mae_y_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
corr.s_y_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
corr.p_y_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)

rmse_alpha_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
nrmse_alpha_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
mae_alpha_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
corr.s_alpha_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
corr.p_alpha_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)

# Vectores para rw2:
rw2_range_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)
rw2_sig_prop_vec <- rep(NA, n_reps)


### BUCLE MONTECARLO ####################################################
for (i in 1:n_reps) {
  
  #cat("Repeticion", i, "de", n_reps, "\n") 
  
  set.seed(1000 + i) #semilla
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # MUESTREO
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # Muestreo aleatorio:
  sample_aleatorio <- sample(1:n, n_samples, replace = FALSE)
  
  # Dataframe con la informacion de las observaciones muestreadas:
  dat <- data.frame(
    intercept = 1,
    id = sample_aleatorio,
    lon = lon[sample_aleatorio],
    lat = lat[sample_aleatorio],
    Cov = X_matrix[sample_aleatorio],
    beta.real = beta.real_matrix[sample_aleatorio],
    eta = eta.real_matrix[sample_aleatorio],
    space = error_matrix[sample_aleatorio],
    resp = y_matrix[sample_aleatorio]
  )
  
  # RW2: discretizar covariable
  X_rw2 <- inla.group(as.numeric(X_matrix), n = n_x)
  dat$X_rw2 <- X_rw2[sample_aleatorio]
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # AJUSTE INLA
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  Loc <- as.matrix(dat[, c("lon", "lat")]) # Localizaciones
  
  mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(Loc, max.edge = c(5, 12), cutoff = 0.5) # Malla
  
  # SPDE para el campo espacial aditivo:
  spde.alpha <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
    mesh = mesh,
    prior.range = c(15, 0.05),
    prior.sigma = c(sd(error_matrix), 0.05)
  )
  
  # Índices espaciales:
  alpha.index <- inla.spde.make.index("alpha", n.spde = spde.alpha$n.spde)
  
  # Matrices proyectoras (A):
  A.alpha <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = Loc)
  
  # Stack:
  stack <- inla.stack(
    data = list(y = dat$resp),
    effects = list(data.frame(
      intercept = dat$intercept,
      X_rw2 = dat$X_rw2),
      alpha = alpha.index
    ),
    A = list(1, A.alpha),
    tag = "est"
  )
  
  # Fórmula: intercepto + alpha(s) + efecto rw2
  formula <- y ~ -1 + intercept + f(X_rw2, model = "rw2", constr = TRUE) + 
    f(alpha, model = spde.alpha)
  
  # Ajuste:
  model <- inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = inla.stack.data(stack),
                control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stack), compute = TRUE), 
                control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
                verbose = FALSE)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # PREDICCION EN TODA LA MALLA
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # Dataframe para la predicción:
  pred <- data.frame(
    lon = lon,
    lat = lat,
    X = as.vector(X_matrix),
    intercept = 1
  )
  pred$X_rw2 <- X_rw2 # Añadimos discretizacion para rw2
  
  Loc.pred <- as.matrix(pred[, c("lon", "lat")])  # Localizaciones prediccion
  
  # Matrices proyectoras para la prediccion:
  A.alpha.pred <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = Loc.pred)
  
  # Stack para la prediccion:
  stack.pred <- inla.stack(
    data = list(y = NA),
    effects = list(
      data.frame(intercept = pred$intercept,
                 X_rw2 = pred$X_rw2),
      alpha = alpha.index
    ),
    A = list(1, A.alpha.pred),
    tag = "pred"
  )
  
  # Stack conjunto: ajuste + predicción:
  stack.full <- inla.stack(stack, stack.pred)
  
  # Reajuste del modelo con el stack conjunto:
  model.pred <- inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = inla.stack.data(stack.full),
                     control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stack.full), compute = TRUE),
                     control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                     control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb"),
                     verbose = FALSE)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # EXTRAER PREDICCIONES
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  alpha.mean <- model.pred$summary.random$alpha$mean
  
  # Alpha:
  alpha.pred <- as.vector(A.alpha.pred %*% alpha.mean)
  alpha.pred.mat <- matrix(alpha.pred, nrow = dims, ncol = dims)
  
   # rw2:
  rw2 <- model.pred$summary.random$X_rw2
  rw2_effect <- rw2$mean[match(pred$X_rw2, rw2$ID)]
  
  # Respuesta:
  beta0_hat.pred <- model.pred$summary.fixed["intercept", "mean"]
  y_hat <- beta0_hat.pred + rw2_effect + alpha.pred
  y_hat.mat <- matrix(y_hat, nrow = dims, ncol = dims)
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # GUARDAR PREDICCIONES
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  y_hat_matrix[, i] <- y_hat
  alpha_hat_matrix[, i] <- alpha.pred
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  # GUARDAR MEDIDAS
  # ---------------------------------------------------
  rmse_y_vec[i] <- rmse(y_hat.mat, y_matrix)
  nrmse_y_vec[i] <- nrmse(y_hat.mat, y_matrix)
  mae_y_vec[i]  <- mae(y_hat.mat, y_matrix)
  corr.s_y_vec[i] <- corr.s(y_hat, as.numeric(y_matrix))
  corr.p_y_vec[i] <- corr.p(y_hat, as.numeric(y_matrix))
  
  rmse_alpha_vec[i] <- rmse(alpha.pred.mat, error_matrix)
  nrmse_alpha_vec[i] <- nrmse(alpha.pred.mat, error_matrix)
  mae_alpha_vec[i]  <- mae(alpha.pred.mat, error_matrix)
  corr.s_alpha_vec[i] <- corr.s(alpha.pred, as.numeric(error_matrix))
  corr.p_alpha_vec[i] <- corr.p(alpha.pred, as.numeric(error_matrix))
  
  dic_vec[i]  <- model$dic$dic
  waic_vec[i] <- model$waic$waic
  
 # RESUMEN DEL RW2:
  rw2_range_vec[i] <- diff(range(rw2$mean, na.rm = TRUE))
  sig <- rw2$`0.025quant` > 0 | rw2$`0.975quant` < 0
  rw2_sig_prop_vec[i] <- mean(sig)
}
### FIN BUCLE MONTECARLO #################################################





#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#------------------------- ANÁLISIS DE LOS RESULTADOS --------------------------
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#---------------------------------------------------
# Resumen numérico medidas de error
#---------------------------------------------------
# RSME:
cat("\nRMSE alpha\n")
print(mean(rmse_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(rmse_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(rmse_alpha_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nRMSE y\n")
print(mean(rmse_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(rmse_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(rmse_y_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

# NRSME:
cat("\nNRMSE alpha\n")
print(mean(nrmse_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(nrmse_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(nrmse_alpha_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nNRMSE y\n")
print(mean(nrmse_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(nrmse_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(nrmse_y_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

# MAE:
cat("\nMAE alpha\n")
print(mean(mae_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(mae_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(mae_alpha_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nMAE y\n")
print(mean(mae_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(mae_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(mae_y_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

# CORRELACION SPEARMAN:
cat("\nCORR.S alpha\n")
print(mean(corr.s_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(corr.s_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(corr.s_alpha_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nCORR.S y\n")
print(mean(corr.s_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(corr.s_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(corr.s_y_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

# CORRELACION PEARSON:
cat("\nCORR.P alpha\n")
print(mean(corr.p_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(corr.p_alpha_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(corr.p_alpha_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nCORR.P y\n")
print(mean(corr.p_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(corr.p_y_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(corr.p_y_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))


# MEDIDAS AJUSTE GLOBAL DEL MODELO:
cat("\nDIC ajuste\n")
print(mean(dic_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(dic_vec, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nWAIC ajuste\n")
print(mean(waic_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(waic_vec, na.rm = TRUE))

# MEDIDAS RW2:
cat("\nRango medio del efecto RW2\n")
print(mean(rw2_range_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(rw2_range_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(rw2_range_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nProporción significativa RW2 (creíblemente distintos de cero)\n")
print(mean(rw2_sig_prop_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(rw2_sig_prop_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(rw2_sig_prop_vec, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))


#---------------------------------------------------
# Resumen gráfico medidas de error
#---------------------------------------------------
# RMSE:
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
hist(rmse_y_vec, main = "RMSE respuesta", xlab = "RMSE")
hist(rmse_alpha_vec, main = "RMSE error espacial", xlab = "RMSE")
boxplot(rmse_y_vec, main = "RMSE respuesta")
boxplot(rmse_alpha_vec, main = "RMSE error espacial")

# NRMSE:
hist(nrmse_y_vec, main = "NRMSE respuesta", xlab = "NRMSE")
hist(nrmse_alpha_vec, main = "NRMSE error espacial", xlab = "NRMSE")
boxplot(nrmse_y_vec, main = "NRMSE respuesta")
boxplot(nrmse_alpha_vec, main = "NRMSE error espacial")

# MAE:
hist(mae_y_vec, main = "MAE respuesta", xlab = "MAE")
hist(mae_alpha_vec, main = "MAE error espacial", xlab = "MAE")
boxplot(mae_y_vec, main = "MAE respuesta")
boxplot(mae_alpha_vec, main = "MAE error espacial")

# CORRELACION PEARSON:
hist(corr.p_y_vec, main = "CORR.P respuesta", xlab = "CORR.P")
hist(corr.p_alpha_vec, main = "CORR.P error espacial", xlab = "CORR.P")
boxplot(corr.p_y_vec, main = "CORR.P respuesta")
boxplot(corr.p_alpha_vec, main = "CORR.P error espacial")

# CORRELACION SPEARMAN:
hist(corr.s_y_vec, main = "CORR.S respuesta", xlab = "CORR.S")
hist(corr.s_alpha_vec, main = "CORR.S error espacial", xlab = "CORR.S")
boxplot(corr.s_y_vec, main = "CORR.S respuesta")
boxplot(corr.s_alpha_vec, main = "CORR.S error espacial")


# MEDIDAS AJUSTE GLOBAL DEL MODELO
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
hist(dic_vec, main = "DIC ajuste", xlab = "DIC")
hist(waic_vec, main = "WAIC ajuste", xlab = "WAIC")
boxplot(dic_vec, main = "DIC ajuste")
boxplot(waic_vec, main = "WAIC ajuste")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))


#---------------------------------------------------
# Resumen numérico estimaciones
# --------------------------------------------------
y_hat_mean <- rowMeans(y_hat_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
y_hat_mean.mat <- matrix(y_hat_mean, nrow=101)
alpha_hat_mean <- rowMeans(alpha_hat_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
alpha_hat_mean.mat <- matrix(alpha_hat_mean, nrow=101)

y_hat_sd <- apply(y_hat_matrix, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
alpha_hat_sd <- apply(alpha_hat_matrix, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nRespuesta: media\n")
print(mean(y_hat_mean, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(y_hat_mean, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(y_hat_mean, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nRespuesta: sd\n")
print(mean(y_hat_sd, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(y_hat_sd, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(y_hat_sd, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nRespuesta: error\n")
print(mean(y_hat_mean.mat-y_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(y_hat_mean.mat-y_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(y_hat_mean.mat-y_matrix, probs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nalpha: media\n")
print(mean(alpha_hat_mean, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(alpha_hat_mean, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(alpha_hat_mean, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nalpha: sd\n")
print(mean(alpha_hat_sd, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(alpha_hat_sd, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(alpha_hat_sd, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nalpha: error\n")
print(mean(alpha_hat_mean.mat-error_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sd(alpha_hat_mean.mat-error_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
print(quantile(alpha_hat_mean.mat-error_matrix, probs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE))


#---------------------------------------------------
# Resumen gráfico estimaciones
# --------------------------------------------------
# Campo espacial residual:
zlim_alpha <- range(c(alpha_hat_mean.mat, error_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)
lim_err_alpha <- max(abs(alpha_hat_mean.mat - error_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)

df_alpha_hat <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_alpha_hat$value <- as.vector(alpha_hat_mean.mat)

df_alpha_real <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_alpha_real$value <- as.vector(error_matrix)

p1 <- ggplot(df_alpha_hat, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main, limits = zlim_alpha) +
  labs(title = "Estimación", x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p2 <- ggplot(df_alpha_real, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main, limits = zlim_alpha) +
  labs(title = "Simulación", x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p1 + p2 +
  plot_annotation(title = expression(alpha(s))) &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))


# Respuesta:
zlim_y <- range(c(y_hat_mean.mat, y_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)
lim_err_y <- max(abs(y_hat_mean.mat - y_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)

df_y_hat <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_y_hat$value <- as.vector(y_hat_mean.mat)

df_y_real <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_y_real$value <- as.vector(y_matrix)

df_y_err <- expand.grid(x = grid_list$x, y = grid_list$y)
df_y_err$value <- as.vector(y_hat_mean.mat - y_matrix)

p1 <- ggplot(df_y_hat, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main, limits = zlim_y) +
  labs(title = "Estimación", x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p2 <- ggplot(df_y_real, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_main, limits = zlim_y) +
  labs(title = "Simulación", x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p3 <- ggplot(df_y_err, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cols_err,
                       limits = c(-lim_err_y, lim_err_y)) +
  labs(title = "Error de predicción", x = "X", y = "Y", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p1 + p2 + p3 +
  plot_annotation(title = expression(y(s))) &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```
